resources.string:
1. On your desktop, open the dashboard link.
2. In the dashboard, open Settings → “Connect app to” and copy the address (tap it to copy).
3. Paste it in “Helper address” below — it looks like wss://your-app.onrender.com/app
4. Type the phone token, tap “Start capturing”, then allow screen capture.
Tip: you can paste just the dashboard link (e.g. https://your-app.onrender.com) — the app adds the rest for you.
Paste the address from the dashboard’s “Connect app to”. Hosted links start with wss:// and end with /app.
Reach this phone from anywhere through your hosted relay — no shared Wi-Fi needed. You get a code to type on the desktop.
Your relay address. Bare hosts default to wss://. The app connects to it and shows your code below.
Your remote code — enter this on the desktop
Recent — tap to connect, long-press to remove
Lets the desktop dashboard tap, swipe, type and press buttons on this phone. Only turn this on for phones you control.
Turn on the “Phone Monitor — Remote control” accessibility service so the desktop can tap, swipe and type on this phone. Screen mirroring works without it.
